home.serverUnreachable: The server could not be reached.
home.noActiveGames: You have no games in progress. Start a new one to set out on a quest.

newGame.title: New Game
newGame.betaWarning: This scenario is in beta: expect bugs. Please report any you find.

starter.dwarves-of-durin: Dwarves of Durin (Dáin Ironfoot, Ori, Bifur)
starter.defenders-of-gondor: Defenders of Gondor (Boromir, Prince Imrahil, Mablung)

mode.title: Mode
mode.easyHint: Each hero starts with 1 extra resource, and the encounter deck leaves out the cards marked as difficult.
mode.hardHint: Use the printed Hard Mode setup, with restricted threat reduction and penalties for healing and readying characters.
mode.nightmareHint: The Nightmare Deck replaces some of the encounter cards, and its setup card stays in play all game.
mode.nightmareCampaignHint: Use Nightmare Decks where available. Later scenarios without a Nightmare Deck use the normal deck.

newGame.allowSpectatorsHint: List this game on the Watch page so anyone can watch it. Spectators see the table but cannot take any actions. This cannot be changed once the game has started.
newGame.publicScoringHint: Using debug, or undoing back past a card being drawn, revealed or looked at, takes the game out of public statistics until it is reset. You are warned before the first time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: The language of the interface and the game's messages. Card names and text stay in English for now.
settings.tableHint: What the game board is laid out on, in this browser.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.none: No games have been played yet.
stats.globalNote: Everyone's statistics only count games played without debug or undoing past revealed cards.
stats.scoreNote: Scores include victories only; lower is better. Rounds include wins and losses. Win rate is wins divided by completed games; started games also include unfinished games.
stats.intro: Explore results by scenario and difficulty, then expand a scenario to compare hero lineups.
stats.tableHint: Expand a scenario to see results by hero lineup.

watch.title: Watch
watch.none: No one is playing a game open to spectators right now.

campaignMode.confirmDelete: Delete this campaign and all its games?
campaignMode.title: Campaign Log
campaignMode.startHint: Play {campaign} in order, one game each, the campaign log carrying your heroes, boons, burdens and threat penalty from one scenario to the next. A lost scenario is played again.
campaignMode.notYetDealt: Recorded once the first scenario is dealt.

note.Prisoner: Taken prisoner at the beginning of Escape from Dol Guldur: {cards}
note.MendorJoinsTheNextCampaign: Mendor joins your next campaign: put him into play at the start of each scenario, and each player may include 1 copy of Mendor's Support.
note.ProtectTheInnocentDamage: Damage noted for Protect the Innocent, later Arnor Ravaged: {cards}
note.LostInMountGram: Left captured in Mount Gram, barred from every deck for the rest of the campaign: {cards}
note.HeroDamage: Damage on each hero at the end of The Battle of Carn Dûm, each beginning The Dread Realm with as much: {cards}
note.CorsairFleetResources: Resources on The Corsair Fleet at the end of The Siege of Gondor, placed on it as The Battle of the Pelennor Fields is set up: {cards}
note.ChoosePendantOrCourage: Choose Iârion's Pendant or Amarthiúl's Courage for the Campaign Pool as The Wastes of Eriador is set up.
note.GraxarDefeated: Graxar was defeated: choose Parrying Cutlass or Throwing Axe, and its hero, as the next scenario is set up.
note.SahirKeyed: Captain Sahír has his Black Key.
note.RecurringNightmares: Choose a player for each Recurring Nightmare as the next scenario is set up: it joins the Campaign Pool, shuffled into their deck after their starting hand: {cards}
note.HaradEnemies: Harad enemies underneath The Black Gate, set aside in The Battle of the Pelennor Fields: {cards}
note.BlackGateResources: Resources on The Black Gate as The Black Gate Opens ended, placed on Mount Doom's campaign card: {cards}
note.CampaignLost: The players lost the campaign: The One Ring was kept, and the power of Sauron endures.
note.Captives: Taken captive at the end of Breaking of the Fellowship: {cards}
note.Treasures: Treasures discovered, each free to add to any player's deck before a game, 1 copy by title: {cards}
note.TuraynsOath: Turayn has taken an oath of vigilance.
note.MelanwarsGuidance: Melanwar has given you guidance on traversing Wilderland.
note.BeldisCare: Beldis's care has bolstered the heroes' spirits.
note.FramsShadeTreasure: A treasure has been attached to Fram's Shade this game.
note.RangerSenseNextCampaign: At the start of your next campaign, each player may shuffle 1 copy of Ranger Sense into their deck and add it to the Campaign Pool.

campaignMode.lost: The scenario was lost: play it again to go on.
campaignMode.spendBetween: XP may be spent between scenarios, while the next one waits in the lobby.
campaignMode.rangerRewardHint: Your rescued Ranger offers each player 1 copy of Ranger Sense for the start of your next campaign.
campaignMode.useRangerReward: Start a new campaign with Ranger Sense
campaignMode.includeRangerReward: Include the Ranger Sense reward from {campaign}
campaignMode.rangerRewardNewHint: Choose which players start the next campaign with 1 Ranger Sense in their deck and the Campaign Pool. Creating the campaign uses this reward once. Standalone games do not use it.
campaignMode.extend: Continue into The Dark of Mirkwood
campaignMode.extendHint: Continue with The Oath and The Caves of Nibin-dûm. Your heroes, scores, boons, burdens and campaign log carry forward.
campaignMode.campaignChoiceHint: Follow a connected story, carrying your heroes and campaign log between adventures.
campaignMode.miniRouteDescription: Just this pack. Begin with a fresh campaign log.
campaignMode.coreRouteDescription: The three original adventures with one campaign log.
campaignMode.fullRouteDescription: Core Set adventures, followed by The Dark of Mirkwood.
campaignMode.standaloneHint: Choose one adventure to play on its own, without a campaign log.
campaignMode.includeOldForest: Include The Old Forest after A Shadow of the Past
campaignMode.includeFog: Include Fog on the Barrow-downs before A Knife in the Dark
campaignMode.coreHint: Play the three Core Set adventures with one campaign log.
campaignMode.miniHint: Begin with The Oath and a fresh campaign log, then continue to The Caves of Nibin-dûm.
campaignMode.extendedHint: Begin with the three Core Set adventures, then continue into The Dark of Mirkwood with the same heroes and campaign log.

epic.title: Epic Multiplayer
epic.description: Play in independent groups of 1–4 players, sharing quest progress and damage to the Dreadnaught. Each group has its own deck, ships, and turns.
epic.annuminasDescription: Defend Annúminas with exactly three teams of 1–4 players. Each team plays at its own stage with its own encounter deck. Finish each round together, resolving end-of-round effects in stage order B, D, F.
epic.annuminasCityHint: All teams defend the same city. If its strength reaches zero, or the last player at any stage is eliminated, all teams lose.
epic.annuminasWaitingHint: Create exactly three groups, one for each stage. Every seat needs a deck before the organizer can start.
epic.advanceHint: The search is complete. Advance at the end of your group’s quest phase.
epic.copyFailed: Copy the invitation link from the field above.
epic.noGroups: Add the first group, then share the event link with the other groups.
epic.readyHint: All groups are ready. Starting locks the player count for the event.
epic.waitingHint: Each group needs a deck in every seat before the organizer can start the event.
epic.organizerStarts: The organizer starts all groups together.
